title: Ashfall County world and sections
requirements: Preserve current runtime behavior and authored source; these records document inspected code/configuration only.
Named sections and mode intent are separate from native verification, checkpoint support and geometry.
Source review only for this migration; no new native playtest was run. Existing saved acceptance evidence retains its original scope.
Empty layouts are explicitly unverified schematic containers. They contain no invented geometry, spawn locations, portals or population rates.
World editor bindings are planning references; none of these documents changes engine state, installs assets, or implements level launching.
WorldGen version 2 declares a 4–6 km seeded county. The empty canonical editor canvas does not represent its generated dimensions/landmarks. Export requires a future game-specific adapter.

notes: No invented portals, spawn rates, coordinates or asset compatibility claims. Empty layouts must be replaced only by reviewed source-derived/captured geometry.
